enable_safety_checker.description: Moderate the source video and the prompt.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Seconds of new footage to add. The continuation clip also includes 1.625 seconds from the source's ending and may be longer because of frame rounding.

video_url.description: URL of the video to extend. Must be 1.625 s to 60 s long, up to 50 MB, aspect ratio between 0.4 and 2.5.
video_url.title: Video Url

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Automatically enhance the prompt using the source video to help keep the continuation consistent. May increase processing time.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. 'auto' follows the source video. Other values crop the video to fit the selected ratio.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

reference_audio_urls.description: Optional audio references for the continuation (2–15 seconds each, 15 seconds combined). The full extended video retains its original source soundtrack, and its ending still conditions the transition. These clips guide the newly generated audio instead of using that soundtrack as an audio reference. Assign each clip a role in the prompt, such as 'Audio 1 for the voice' and 'Audio 2 for background music'.
reference_audio_urls.title: Reference Audio URLs

prompt.description: What happens next. Describe the continuation, not the source.
prompt.title: Prompt

seed.description: Seed for the continuation. Random when omitted.
seed.title: Seed

output.description: 'extended' returns the source and new footage as one video. 'continuation' returns a clip that starts with a 1.625-second repeat of the source's ending, then shows the new footage.
output.title: Output

video.description: The returned video. In 'continuation' mode, it includes the 1.625-second repeat at the start.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

video.title: File

source.description: Source video information: width, height, frame rate, duration, and audio.
source.title: Source

expanded_prompt.description: The prompt used after expansion, or null when unchanged.
expanded_prompt.title: Expanded Prompt
